name: Sepulchrine-Drumlin
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by tectonic rift valleys. Beyond massive canyon systems, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Slow groves of photosynthetic columns migrate centimeters a season toward the light.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Whoever controls uranium controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
